resolved_conflicts.explanation: Three sources name the Gifford Pinchot National Forest; Washington Lookouts names the Snoqualmie National Forest. The story uses Gifford Pinchot and says the sources differ.

notes_for_editor: The brief says Newaukum shares a register number with another record. FFLOS gives US 1288, WA 188; the other record was not traced. Elevation: the record's 988.8 m matches FireLookout's 3,244 ft, while WillhiteWeb's 3,791 ft is unreconciled and the record was not changed. Fate: removed (FFLOS, Washington Lookouts) versus destroyed (FireLookout, WillhiteWeb) is unresolved; the 1960 event year is a placeholder for the decade. A web search returned an unfetched Facebook post saying an old 1934 L-4 cab is down the road a little ways from the summit. It does not name this lookout and was not used, but it would contradict gone if it is Newaukum, so check it. No source read covers staffing or fires.
